notablePrerequisites:
Blazing Sunsteel attached to Sporeweb Weaver.
You have a way to give Sporeweb Weaver indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Sporeweb Weaver.
description:
Give Sporeweb Weaver indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Sporeweb Weaver.
Sporeweb Weaver and Blazing Sunsteel trigger.
Resolve the Sporeweb Weaver trigger, creating a 1/1 green Saproling creature token and gaining you 1 life.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing at least one damage to Sporeweb Weaver.
Repeat from step 3.
